rulings.evidence: A can of chopped tomatoes is canned diced tomatoes, same product and price class; refused the board's fresh tomatoes match as a different food and gram basis.
Refused the board's dried-basil match under the standing fresh-is-not-dried rejection: different price class and 14 g fresh is not 2 g dried.

new_commodity_proposals.evidence: Board ABSENT (no commodity, no capture). No existing id prices dried chilli flakes: paprika, smoked-paprika and cayenne are ground powders, a different product and a different gram basis per teaspoon. The only board match is dried-basil, the estate's standing form-flip rejection: fresh basil is a refrigerated clamshell or living pot at a different price class, and 24 fresh leaves weigh about 14 g against under 2 g dried. Checked pesto (a prepared sauce) and bay-leaves (a different plant); neither prices this food.
